text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A and Stock E after gains of about 17%, and later sold Stock D and Stock C for smaller gains; I should not let the pleasure of realizing a gain alone decide when to sell.","A holding’s average cost is not a reason to treat it as a separate account: I should weigh its prospects and fit in my overall portfolio, even when selling at a loss feels painful.","My account value moved up and down while I often made no trades; as a long-term, infrequent trader, I should review calmly and act deliberately rather than react to short-term changes."]}
